cues: Direct chlorination cannot be stopped cleanly at one chlorine, and cannot put it at a chosen position.
Aniline is diazotised with sodium nitrite and hydrochloric acid in ice, at two seventy three to two seventy eight kelvin, giving benzene diazonium chloride.
Then the diazonium group is swapped for chlorine, and nitrogen gas bubbles off.
text: Direct chlorination cannot be stopped cleanly at one chlorine, and cannot put it at a chosen position. The diazonium route can. Aniline is diazotised with sodium nitrite and hydrochloric acid in ice, at two seventy three to two seventy eight kelvin, giving benzene diazonium chloride. Then the diazonium group is swapped for chlorine, and nitrogen gas bubbles off.
